mapper.sql: SELECT a.id AS attendance_id, a.member_id, m.name AS member_name, m.phone, mp.name AS membership_name, a.attendance_date, a.checked_in_at, a.checked_out_at, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, a.checked_in_at, COALESCE(a.checked_out_at, CASE WHEN a.time_zone = 'Asia/Seoul' THEN #{centerNow} ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END)) AS duration_minutes, CASE WHEN a.checked_out_at IS NULL THEN 'IN_CENTER' ELSE 'CHECKED_OUT' END AS attendance_status FROM attendances a JOIN members m ON m.id = a.member_id LEFT JOIN member_memberships mm ON mm.id = ( SELECT mm2.id FROM member_memberships mm2 WHERE mm2.member_id = m.id AND mm2.status = 'ACTIVE' AND a.attendance_date BETWEEN mm2.start_date AND mm2.end_date ORDER BY mm2.end_date, mm2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN membership_products mp ON mp.id = mm.product_id
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN attendance_date = #{date} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS checked_in_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN checked_out_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS current_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN attendance_date = #{date} AND checked_out_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS checked_out_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN checked_out_at IS NULL AND attendance_date < #{centerToday} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS missing_checkout_count FROM attendances

WHERE a.checked_out_at IS NULL
AND (m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY a.checked_in_at DESC

a.attendance_date = #{resolvedDate}
AND (m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND a.checked_out_at IS NULL AND a.checked_out_at IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY a.checked_in_at DESC
WHERE a.id = #{attendanceId} AND a.checked_out_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
WHERE a.member_id = #{memberId} AND a.checked_out_at IS NULL ORDER BY a.checked_in_at DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE attendances SET checked_out_at = CASE WHEN time_zone = 'Asia/Seoul' THEN #{checkedOutAt} ELSE #{legacyCheckedOutAt} END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{attendanceId} AND checked_out_at IS NULL AND checked_in_at <= CASE WHEN time_zone = 'Asia/Seoul' THEN #{checkedOutAt} ELSE #{legacyCheckedOutAt} END
mapper.select: SELECT m.id FROM members m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT id FROM members WHERE id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM attendances WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND checked_out_at IS NULL)

SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM attendances a JOIN members m ON m.id = a.member_id JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND a.checked_out_at IS NULL )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendances(member_id, attendance_date, checked_in_at, time_zone) VALUES(#{memberId}, #{attendanceDate}, #{checkedInAt}, 'Asia/Seoul')
